parts.name: Cover
parts.Basic_description: This is the cover of a trash can, made of polypropylene plastic. It is a flat, slightly curved lid designed to fit securely on top of the container.
parts.Functional_description: The cover prevents odors from escaping and keeps the contents of the trash can concealed. It may be lifted or flipped open when disposing of waste.
parts.Movement_description: It can be lifted, rotated, or hinged depending on the design, allowing access to the container below.

parts.name: Container
parts.Basic_description: This is the main container body of the trash can, made of polypropylene plastic. It has a rectangular shape with rounded edges and a smooth surface.
parts.Functional_description: The container holds and stores waste materials. It supports the cover and may accommodate a trash bag inside.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during normal use but can be lifted or carried when emptying or cleaning.
